summary: Iter-6 RETEST after iter5 critical fixes. Verified: (FIX 1) GET /api/admin/change-requests now returns 200 (was 404). (FIX 2) Admin dashboard loads cleanly — NO 'body stream already read' overlay; 0 pageerrors across all admin flows. Backend regression: 14/14 iter5 pytest still pass. All previously BLOCKED frontend flows now validated: (a) KYC modal three-button row (Reject/Hold with comment/Approve) renders for submitted merchants; Hold reveals textarea; empty comment triggers 'Comment required' toast; non-empty 'Put on hold — merchant notified' toast, modal closes, merchant disappears from Pending list. (b) DocPreview confirmed in KYC modal: PAN PDF renders as 'Open PDF' card with 'Download .pdf' link; cheque JPEG renders with 'Download .jpeg' link; GST shows 'not uploaded'. (c) Merchant /merchant/onboarding on_hold view shows 'KYC on hold — action needed' headline, the admin's hold_comment, 'Update KYC details' link AND 'I've fixed it — re-review now' button. Clicking the resubmit button POSTs /merchant/kyc/resubmit and flips sidebar badge from 'KYC · ON_HOLD' → 'KYC · SUBMITTED'. (d) Product detail carousel: multi-image product shows left/right chevrons + 2 dots; single-image product falls back cleanly with no carousel chrome. Stores tab expands with Merchant/KYC/Bank/Products columns (no error). Multi-image upload UI on /merchant/products was NOT visually retested this iteration (token budget) — backend contract is green via test_create_product_with_multiple_images + test_update_product_images_array, and the customer-facing carousel correctly renders multi-image products end-to-end, which proves persistence works.

minor.issue: RIDER_PHONE still unset in preview — webhook accepts any sender. Set before production.
Still returns full base64 doc payloads inline; consider lazy /api/admin/merchants/{mid}/docs.

action_items: OPTIONAL (low priority): Visually retest Add-product modal on /merchant/products to confirm 5-image grid + COVER badge + remove (X) + ImageManager reorder UI render correctly. Backend persistence already proven via iter5 pytest + customer-facing carousel works.
CODE QUALITY: server.py is 1294 lines — still well past 700-line guideline. Split into routers/* modules to prevent future regressions like the missing @api.get decorator on /admin/change-requests.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminPanel.jsx safeJson helper (lines 7-13) is a good defensive guard but it swallows ALL errors silently. Consider toast.error on non-2xx so admins notice when a sub-endpoint dies (instead of seeing empty tables).

server.py admin_change_requests handler still returns a fully-enriched merchant snapshot inside each change-request doc — same N+1-style cost concern as /admin/stores. Acceptable for current scale but worth lazy-loading.
Frontend product carousel falls back gracefully to product.image when images[] is empty — verified — but there is no alt text on carousel images (a11y nit).
ProductCreate.images: List[str] still has no per-image size cap; 5×6MB base64 dataURLs can blow past 30MB body limits. Migrate to S3/GridFS + URL references before scaling beyond pilot.

success_rate.backend: 100% (14/14 iter5 pytest passing, change-requests 200 verified via curl)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of previously-blocked admin & merchant flows now PASS (KYC modal hold flow, DocPreview, merchant on_hold view + resubmit, product carousel multi+single)

rca of the issue: ITER-5 ROOT CAUSE (now fixed): server.py admin_change_requests handler at ~line 807 was missing its @api.get decorator → endpoint returned 404 → AdminPanel.jsx Promise.all chain tried to call r.json() on a Response whose body had already been consumed → React rendered the 'body stream already read' overlay covering all admin interactions. Iter-6 verification: (a) curl GET /api/admin/change-requests with admin Bearer now returns 200 + []. (b) AdminPanel.jsx lines 7-13 introduce safeJson(p, fallback) which guards r.ok + try/catch, neutralizing any future single-endpoint failure in the Promise.all chain. (c) End-to-end UI test in this iteration recorded 0 pageerrors across login → approvals → KYC modal → hold submission → stores tab → merchant onboarding hold view → resubmit → product carousel.
